title.zh: Bitdeer 公布 9 月 GPU 利用率 95%，馬來西亞 A201 列分階段交付時程
title.en: Bitdeer reports 95% September GPU utilization and staged delivery dates for Malaysia A201

summary.zh: Bitdeer 於台灣時間 10 月 20 日公布 9 月未經審計營運更新，集團 AI Cloud GPU 利用率由 8 月 92% 升至 95%，已部署 GPU 維持 4,328 顆。馬來西亞柔佛新山 A201 約 21.7 MW 計畫已有逾七成長約涵蓋，仍未全面上線，機房就緒與完整部署列為不同節點。
summary.en: Bitdeer’s October 19 US release, published October 20 in Taiwan, reports September group AI Cloud GPU utilization of 95%, versus 92% in August, with deployed GPUs unchanged at 4,328. Its approximately 21.7 MW A201 project in Johor Bahru has over 70% long-term contract coverage but is not fully live, with separate readiness and deployment milestones.

location.en: Project site: A201 data center, Johor Bahru, Malaysia; the release also lists Malaysian A101 as live.

label.en: Supply chain and reported operating data

text.zh: GPU 訂閱服務連結伺服器機櫃、電源轉換、液冷與機房供電。9 月外部訂閱 GPU 為 4,007 顆，8 月為 3,998 顆；這些是集團合計，不是馬來西亞單一基地數字。公司另列馬來西亞 A101 的 2.5 MW 已上線，與 A201 規劃容量分開。
text.en: GPU subscriptions connect racks, power conversion, liquid cooling and site power. External subscriptions rose to 4,007 GPUs from 3,998; these are group figures, not Malaysian site totals. A101’s 2.5 MW is listed as live, separately from planned A201 capacity.

text.zh: 公司列 9 月年化收入運行率約 8,600 萬美元、收入儲備約 29 億美元，8 月分別為 8,600 萬及 9 億美元。前者按月底當日契約 GPU 收入乘 365，後者為未來合約收入，不是已認列年度營收。A201 表格列 2027 年 1 月機房就緒，正文列同年 4 月完整部署及上線目標，並稱已採購逾 100 櫃 GB300 NVL72。
text.en: ARR is approximately US$86 million and backlog US$2.9 billion, versus US$86 million and US$0.9 billion in August. ARR annualizes month-end daily contracted GPU revenue; backlog is future contractual revenue, not recognized annual sales. A201 lists January 2027 readiness and April full deployment, with over 100 GB300 NVL72 racks procured.

text.zh: 數字為公司未經審計更新；A201 一月機房就緒與四月全面上線的驗收定義、實際通電及收入認列時點未完整說明。
text.en: Figures are unaudited company disclosures. Acceptance definitions for January readiness versus April go-live, actual energization and revenue-recognition timing are not fully explained.

title.zh: 神雲台灣 126.2 億元投資案公開，規劃楊梅新廠及竹南、林口擴線
title.en: MiTAC’s NT$12.62 billion Taiwan plan covers a new Yangmei plant and two expansions

summary.zh: 投資臺灣事務所 10 月 19 日公開神雲科技約新台幣 126.2 億元投資案，規劃在桃園楊梅新建工廠，並擴增竹南與林口既有產線，預計新增 300 名本國員工。官方原文載明 10 月 16 日核准，這次公開的是伺服器與整機櫃製造計畫，尚無完工或投產日期。
summary.en: Invest Taiwan disclosed MiTAC Computing’s approximately NT$12.62 billion plan on October 19 for a new Yangmei plant and expansion in Zhunan and Linkou, with 300 planned domestic jobs. The official text dates approval to October 16; completion and production-start dates were not disclosed.

location.zh: 專案地點：台灣桃園市楊梅區新廠；苗栗縣竹南及新北市林口既有廠區擴線。
location.en: Project sites: new plant in Yangmei, Taoyuan, Taiwan; existing facilities in Zhunan, Miaoli and Linkou, New Taipei.

text.zh: 神雲是神達控股旗下、以 MiTAC Computing 品牌供應資料中心及企業級伺服器的公司。官方列出從伺服器平台延伸至機櫃、AI 叢集與 OCP 架構，並研發氣冷及液冷；產線將導入 AIoT、智慧倉儲物流、自動組裝與 AI 視覺，涵蓋整機及工廠自動化。
text.en: MiTAC Computing, part of MiTAC Holdings, supplies data-center and enterprise servers. The release describes rack and AI-cluster integration, OCP architecture, air and liquid cooling, and planned AIoT, warehouse logistics, automated assembly and machine vision.

text.zh: 計畫另含企業 AI 算力中心、能源管理與太陽能；LEED 黃金級是爭取中的認證目標。126.2 億元是整體計畫金額，未按廠區分列，也不是當期設備支出實績。經濟日報將核准寫為 19 日，日期採官方原文的 16 日，19 日保留為公開日期。
text.en: The plan includes an enterprise AI computing center, energy management and solar power; LEED Gold is an aspiration, not an awarded certification. NT$12.62 billion is the overall plan, without site allocations or current spending totals. Economic Daily dates approval to October 19; the official text’s October 16 is retained as approval, with October 19 as disclosure.

text.zh: 廠區別資本支出、伺服器或機櫃年產能、供電核定量與完工投產日期尚未公布。
text.en: Site-level spending, annual server or rack capacity, approved power allocation and completion/start-up dates remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 宸鴻公布兩年 60 億元 TGV 擴建規劃，預告 300 毫米玻璃面板展品
title.en: TPK outlines a two-year NT$6 billion TGV plan and a 300 mm glass-panel exhibit

summary.zh: 宸鴻 10 月 19 日透過新聞稿表示，規劃兩年內在台灣逐步投入新台幣 60 億元，擴建玻璃通孔（TGV）廠房及產線，並預告在 TPCA Show 展出 300 × 300 毫米面板。中壢試產線正與封裝業者共同開發樣品，核心驗證以 2027 年底為目標，量產則預計 2028 年。
summary.en: TPK said in an October 19 release reported by CNA that it plans NT$6 billion over two years for Taiwanese through-glass-via facilities and lines, and a 300 × 300 mm panel exhibit at TPCA Show. Its Zhongli pilot line is developing samples with packaging companies, targeting core validation by end-2027 and production in 2028.

location.zh: 專案地點：台灣桃園中壢試產廠；展覽場地：台北南港展覽館 1 館 1、4 樓，TPCA Show 10/20 至 10/22。
location.en: Project site: Zhongli pilot facility, Taoyuan, Taiwan. Exhibition venue: Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center Hall 1, floors 1 and 4, October 20–22.

text.zh: TGV 連結玻璃基板加工、金屬填孔、電性量測及先進封裝。宸鴻稱與清華大學電資學院合作建立模型；300 毫米是方形展品的邊長，不是晶圓產能。10 月 15 日報導已提及試產線，因此新增資訊是這次投資規劃與展品細節，不是首次建成產線。
text.en: TGV connects glass processing, metal-filled vias, electrical measurement and advanced packaging. TPK cites modeling work with National Tsing Hua University. The 300 mm figure is panel side length, not wafer capacity. An October 15 report already described the pilot line; the new details are the spending plan and exhibits.

text.zh: 主辦單位確認 TPCA Show 為 10 月 20 至 22 日、南港 1 館；IMPACT-IAAC 為 19 至 22 日、南港 2 館，兩者場館不同。兩年投入、驗證與量產日期均為公司規劃，不能當成已完成客戶認證或商用交付。
text.en: The organizer places TPCA Show in Nangang Hall 1 on October 20–22, and IMPACT-IAAC in Hall 2 on October 19–22. Spending, validation and production dates are company plans, not completed customer qualification or commercial delivery.

text.zh: 未直接取得公司新聞稿原件；客戶名單、量產良率、實際支出與認證完成日期未公布，技術及時程依公司對外說法。
text.en: The original company release was not directly retrieved. Customer names, production yields, actual spending and completed qualification dates are undisclosed; technical and timing claims remain company statements.

title.zh: Aolani 簽馬來西亞最高 500 MW 意向書，仍待正式協議
title.en: Aolani signs non-binding LOIs for up to 500 MW in Malaysia

summary.zh: 新加坡 Aolani 10 月 19 日宣布，已簽意向書擬取得馬來西亞多處最高 500 MW AI 資料中心容量，目標自 2027 年下半年開始上線。公司明列意向書不具約束力，須再洽簽正式協議，未公開基地城市、供電條件或投資金額。
summary.en: Singapore-based Aolani announced October 19 that it signed LOIs for up to 500 MW of AI data-center capacity across Malaysian sites, targeting service from H2 2027. The LOIs are non-binding and subject to definitive agreements; cities, power conditions and investment value remain undisclosed.

metricLabel.zh: 非約束性意向書容量上限

location.zh: 專案地點：馬來西亞多處基地，城市及場址未公布；公告發布於新加坡。
location.en: Project sites: multiple locations in Malaysia, with cities and sites undisclosed; announcement issued in Singapore.

text.zh: Aolani 將提供 AI 基礎設施、GPU 部署及營運需求；機房屬設計符合 Tier III，未稱已獲認證。公司稱 2026 年已承諾容量約 80 MW，目標 2027 年合計最高 580 MW；80 MW 不是已營運容量、580 MW 也不是此次新增量。官網與 TNGlobal 日期為 10/19，ACCESS 發稿頁列 10/18 23:45、未註明時區，實際簽字日未列。
text.en: Aolani would provide AI infrastructure, GPU deployment and operating requirements. Sites are designed to Tier III standards, not stated as certified. It reports approximately 80 MW committed in 2026 and targets up to 580 MW by 2027, neither equivalent to live capacity or incremental capacity alone. Its site and TNGlobal date the news October 19; ACCESS lists October 18 at 23:45 without a time zone or signing date.

text.zh: 意向書不具約束力；交易對手、基地、正式合約、供電核定、實際營運容量及簽署日期未公布。
text.en: The LOIs are non-binding. Counterparties, sites, definitive contracts, approved power, live capacity and signing date remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 力成公告向 Onto 購買封裝設備，交易期間合計約 7.39 億元
title.en: PTI discloses approximately NT$739 million in Onto packaging-equipment purchases

summary.zh: 力成 10 月 19 日公告向 Onto Innovation 取得封裝設備一批，9 月 30 日至 10 月 19 日交易金額合計新台幣 7 億 3,855 萬元。資訊來自專業媒體轉載重大訊息，確認的是設備交易，未說明交付、裝機、驗收或特定 HBM 產線。
summary.en: PTI disclosed October 19 that packaging-equipment purchases from Onto Innovation totaled NT$738.55 million over September 30–October 19. The filing reproduced by professional media describes purchases, without delivery, installation, acceptance or assignment to a specific HBM line.

text.zh: 力成官方封裝服務包含記憶體與 SSD 用途；Onto 官方業務涵蓋檢測、量測及微影設備。兩家公司業務背景不等於本批設備的具體用途，公告未列型號，不能據此指認為 Dragonfly G5、HBM 或面板級封裝擴產。金額是交易區間合計，不是 10/19 單日支出，也未提供同比基期。
text.en: PTI’s official packaging materials describe memory and SSD applications, while Onto supplies inspection, metrology and lithography tools. These business descriptions do not identify this equipment batch as Dragonfly G5, HBM or panel-level packaging capacity. The amount spans the disclosed transaction period, not one day, and no year-earlier base is provided.

title.zh: 臻鼎泰國子公司揭露近一年設備交易，累計約 10.86 億元
title.en: Zhen Ding’s Thai subsidiary discloses nearly a year of equipment purchases totaling NT$1.086 billion

summary.zh: 臻鼎-KY 10 月 19 日代泰國子公司公告，向 SYMTEK AUTOMATION CHINA 取得營業用設備一批，2025 年 10 月 20 日至 2026 年 10 月 19 日累計金額約新台幣 10.86 億元。這是近一年交易期間的彙總，不是單日新增投資，也未列本批設備的驗收產能。
summary.en: Zhen Ding disclosed October 19 that its Thai subsidiary purchased operating equipment from SYMTEK AUTOMATION CHINA, totaling approximately NT$1.086 billion over October 20, 2025–October 19, 2026. This aggregates nearly a year of transactions, not a single day of new investment, and provides no accepted capacity for the equipment.

title.en: NCU and four PCB companies sign NT$60 million education and research partnership

summary.zh: 中央大學 10 月 19 日在桃園與臻鼎、台光、大量及尖點簽署合作，四家合計提供新台幣 6,000 萬元，串連課程、企業專班、實習與共同研發。計畫涵蓋 PCB 材料及精密製程人才，也提出虛擬 PCB 學院構想，並非新增工廠產能公告。
summary.en: National Central University signed a partnership in Taoyuan on October 19 with Zhen Ding, Elite Material, Ta Liang and Topoint, with NT$60 million combined support for courses, company programs, internships and joint research. The PCB-materials and precision-process initiative includes a proposed virtual PCB college, rather than new factory capacity.

text.zh: 合作夥伴跨越電路板、銅箔基板材料與加工設備、工具，校方將整合跨領域教學及產業研究。校方新聞稿刊於中央社訊息平台，屬大學自行提供內容；中央社另有記者報導。6,000 萬元是四家合計金額，不是每家各投入相同金額，也不是已支付款項的查核結果。
text.en: Partners span circuit boards, copper-clad laminate materials, machining equipment and tools. NCU plans interdisciplinary teaching and industry research. Its release on CNA’s submission platform is university-provided material, distinct from CNA’s separate reporting. NT$60 million is the combined amount, not an equal per-company payment or audited disbursement.

title.zh: 中油通霄至大潭第二海管環評初審要求補件，尚未通過
title.en: CPC’s second Tongxiao–Datan pipeline faces further EIA review after requests for supplements

summary.zh: 據中央社，約 85.5 公里的中油通霄至大潭第二海底輸氣管線，10 月 19 日第二次環評初審仍須補充資料後再審，並未通過。審查涉及工程必要性、海域生態與施工影響；中油則稱管線與第三天然氣接收站功能不同，屬供氣網路備援規劃。
summary.en: CNA reports that CPC’s approximately 85.5 km second Tongxiao–Datan subsea gas pipeline was sent for further review after its second preliminary EIA meeting on October 19. The review concerns necessity, marine ecology and construction effects; CPC says the line has a different function from its third LNG terminal and forms part of supply-network backup planning.

location.zh: 專案路線：台灣苗栗通霄輸氣中心，經苗栗、新竹、桃園外海，於桃園新屋上岸並銜接大潭。
location.en: Project route: Tongxiao gas transmission center, Miaoli, Taiwan, offshore via Miaoli, Hsinchu and Taoyuan, landing in Xinwu, Taoyuan, toward Datan.

text.zh: 天然氣輸送屬發電燃料上游基礎設施，與資料中心或工廠個別供電契約並不相同。報導指委員要求補充需求合理性、生態調查及陸域工程影響；中油提出的備援理由是開發單位說明，審查尚未定案。補件再審也不是永久否決，不能推定已改變任何用戶的電價或供電可靠度。
text.en: Gas transport is upstream fuel infrastructure, distinct from individual data-center or factory power contracts. The report describes requests on demand justification, ecological surveys and land works. CPC’s backup rationale is the developer’s position; review is unresolved. Further review is not permanent rejection and does not establish changed user tariffs or reliability.

text.zh: 未直接取得會議紀錄或中油原始聲明；審查進度與立場依中央社報導，最終條件、施工及通氣日期尚未確認。
text.en: Meeting minutes and CPC’s original statement were not directly retrieved. Review status and positions rely on CNA; final conditions, construction and gas-in dates remain unconfirmed.

text.en: Price moves, broker projections and recycled announcements without new contracts, production or acceptance information were not selected as new developments.

verificationNote.zh: 宸鴻技術與時程依公司說法的專業報導；力成及臻鼎設備公告以重大訊息轉載核對，未直接取得原件；海管審查依中央社報導，未取得會議紀錄。Bitdeer 為未經審計營運資料，A201 的一月與四月是不同節點；Aolani 意向書不具約束力且分發稿日期相差一天。神雲核准日採官方 10/16，公開日為 10/19。所有規劃容量、目標及收入儲備均非已完成實績；月度比較未標作 QoQ，也未反推缺少的基期。
verificationNote.en: TPK technical and timing claims rely on professional reporting of company statements; PTI and Zhen Ding purchases were checked through filing reproductions without direct originals. Pipeline review relies on CNA without meeting minutes. Bitdeer data are unaudited, with separate January and April A201 milestones. Aolani’s LOIs are non-binding and distributed releases differ by one date. MiTAC approval follows the official October 16 date, with disclosure October 19. Planned capacity, targets and backlog are not completed results; monthly comparisons are not labeled QoQ and missing bases are not reverse-calculated.
